description: Editable table block. The Table block itself carries the shape (column count, header flags, per-column alignment); its rows are separate TableRow blocks loaded as children via IBlockProvider.GetChildBlocksAsync(tableId) and ordered by Order. Supports adding/deleting rows and columns, a header row and header column, cell range selection with merge/split, cell background colours, column sorting, row drag-and-drop, and undo of the last table change.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The Table block. Its Id is used to load the child TableRow blocks.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: Table shape: ColumnCount, HasHeaderRow, HasHeaderColumn and ColumnAlignments (per-column alignment carried over from a GFM separator row).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Hides the toolbar, row handles and add-row/add-column affordances, and renders cells non-editable.

parameters.name: OnUpdated
parameters.description: Fired when the table block itself changes (column count, header flags).

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when any cell inside the table receives focus.

examples.title: Render a table block
examples.code:
@* Rows are fetched as child blocks of the Table block through the cascaded NotionEditorContext *@
<TmNotionTableBlock Block="@_tableBlock"
                    Content="@((ITableBlockContent)_tableBlock.Content)"
                    OnUpdated="HandleTableUpdatedAsync" />
